method: Specific-C dagger: supervised forest proximity retrieves patient contexts; final expert predictions still come from frozen TabICL-v2.
source_training: Existing full source pool plus32 target-context patients; forest64trees depth4 minleaf8, source/target loss mass.8/.2
retrieval: RF shared-leaf proximity; farthest-first8or16 training-pool anchors; query assignment by proximity; nearest64,128,256 context rows; ensure both classes. ID contexts source-only; OOD contexts include up to32 target-training rows.
clinical_labels_not_in_context: Source and target calibration, validation and final test patients are excluded from retrieval pool.
models: Native TabICL-v2 n_estimators1, row cap256, samecheckpoint, no backbone weight training.
calibration: Cross-fitted reference Shared predictions and Platt probabilities; learned capped logit residual, as v20.
source_and_target_supervision: All Base/Shared/Specific have same available pools; supervised learned retrieval is explicitly additional algorithmic processing.
reference: Forest standalone output also reported separately.
selection: Development accuracy only with Shared fallback. No final labels, ranking filters, or numeric-band selection.
